text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Nakayama Festa's
debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a little free time today, so I head
over to
take notes while watching some
of the students
run.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right, let's go! Follow me, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kita! Hmph... You know, partner
running
means we're supposed to start
together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But... today will be the day I catch up
with you
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some racers take the lead, setting the
pace while
trying to break away. Others
focus on a chosen
racer, biding their
time until they have a chance
to pull
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The running styles of each Umamusume
are
largely shaped by their personalities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Front runner, pace chaser, late surger,
end
closer—though each runner may
have their own
style...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You don't say. If this is Suzuka's
front-running
pace, then I should
probably take it easy during
the middle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some front runners charge ahead
without a
second thought, while others
carefully consider
their surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, understanding each racer
can be
what brings us to finding a
winning strategy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm keenly aware of her thrill-seeking
spirit, but
beyond that, I still don't know
much of her
background.
choice_data_list: その点でいうとナカヤマフェスタは……
choice_data_list_en: In that regard, Nakayama Festa is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her likes and dislikes, even her little
quirks, may
seem unrelated to racing at
a glance, but they
can provide a lot of
useful information.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never even asked her about when
she first
decided to pursue Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I wanted to thank you for
the other
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I reply, I remember our previous
discussion.
choice_data_list: いえ、こちらもお世話になりました！
choice_data_list_en: Not at all, thank you for taking such good care of me too!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to double-check with my
father whether
we've got any more
useful footage of Festa lying
around.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I want to do as much as I can to help,
even if it's
only a little.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: 今度じっくりインタビューできませんか！？
choice_data_list_en: Could we do an in-depth interview with you sometime!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You want me to come with you to
Teach's dad's
racing school?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I first made sure with them that both the

circumstances and scheduling wouldn't
be an
inconvenience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My hope is to glean something about
Nakayama
Festa, either directly from her
mentor, or by
seeing the way they
interact.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: 予定としては今年の秋口くらいで
choice_data_list_en: The plan is for around early autumn this year.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's a little far out from now... but I'm
guessing
it's to accommodate Teach,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: How does it suit me? Uhhh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm not gonna say no.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...Tch, I suppose this is what happens
when two
do-gooders start plotting
together.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Your type just can't help but poke your
noses
into other people's business.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Outta the way! I said mooove!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heads up, Nakayama! Got a package for
ya!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Golshi. Making a racket as usual,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(This is Gold Ship. She's usually spouting
off
nonsense, but she really knows how
to live life to
the fullest. She's a wild
one.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (However...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: C-come on... What do you even want?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... Is she making you cry, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(This is my classmate, Tosen
Jordan—one of
Golshi's favorite targets.
And since Golshi is in
abnormally high
spirits, it can only mean...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(She's looking for someone to join her in
one of
her annoying schemes.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, gimme the gold tie! I can't show my
face
back at the office without it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Golshi. Time to turn around. The
treasure
map is far off in the distant
future.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Ring, ring, ring! The Golshi Emergency Call Center is receiving an emergency call!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well then, off you go!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Laaaterz!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! What was all that about?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd have learned by now,
Jordan.
Can't you see that your reaction
just feeds her
excitement?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, time to head back to your own
territory
before Golshi corners you
again.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um... O-okay...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Bye now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: W-wait!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Aha. ☆ Well, actually...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You know how we're, like, classmates,
right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, there was something I wanted to
ask you!
Yeah, like, I wanted to know...
what you thought
about the debut race!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Didn't it feel, like, wow, this is totally
different
from training?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I was so nervous, I could barely move!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But the really strong Umamusume who
win G1
races don't even break a sweat,
right? It's just
normal for them...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, I figured... I'm probably on the losing
side...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Wild. Why am I even saying all
this?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me! Haven't the teachers
been
super annoying lately? Always
talking about how
we need to "think
about the future" or whatever.
Like, who
cares about that?! So lame!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nakayama. But you said something
about
taking on the world, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Are you, like, serious about that? Does
it mean
you're gonna enter any junior
year G1 races? Or
are you planning to
take on the Classic Triple
Crown?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, sure. But...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not aiming for anything in particular
right
now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Y'know. We just figured it's not time to
make a
decision yet. So, nothing's set in
stone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ooh! ☆ You're the same as me, then!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I totally understand you. It's all so
overwhelming,
right? Reality is just so
crazy, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I can't think straight at all! I'm
starving!
Wanna go grab a burger or
something?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm good. I just ate a little while ago.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a bummer! You have to come
next time,
then! No backing out. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Classmates have gotta stick together,
you know?
Haha, catch you later! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...That was unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Licking each other's
wounds? Take it
somewhere private if
you are.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ew. Spare me the stupid comments.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(This here is Sirius Symboli, my
roommate. She
apparently stayed in
Europe for a time and got to
run in a G1
there.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. I should be asking you. You ran
in the
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe before,
right? Tell me
about it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, is that how you go about asking for
a favor?
How about you bow your head
and show some
manners first? Geez...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmmm hm hmm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Such a troublemaker.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh?
